name: Affirmative cyber formations
description: Short-lived futuristic formations applied to ordinary commercial and social network activity.
cause_of_death: Affirmative formations were displaced by e- forms and ordinary online descriptions; security vocabulary remained productive.

sources.title: Where does the word cyber come from?
sources.note: Oxford Dictionaries retrospective distinguishes displaced affirmative formations from continuing security terminology.

sources.title: Cyberwoerter
sources.note: Linguist Anatol Stefanowitsch supplies OED attestation years; these establish onset evidence, not measured peaks.

entries.gloss: A collection of online shops presented as a virtual shopping destination.

examples.text: Could you check the cybermall for a replacement cartridge?

entries.rationale: Oxford documents displacement of affirmative cyber formations. The lexical onset follows reported OED attestation; 1996 peak and 2002 fade are curation estimates, not individual frequency observations.
